title: Finite family covering the base by normal fibers
statement: Let A be a Noetherian domain, K its fraction field, and suppose A has a nonzero f such that all prime localizations of A_f are integrally closed. Suppose for every maximal ideal m of A there is a finite A-subalgebra C of K, contained in the integral closure of A in K, such that all prime localizations of C above m are integrally closed. Then there is a finite set s of finite A-subalgebras contained in the integral closure such that for every prime p of A, some C in s has integrally closed localizations at every prime of C contracting to p.

proof.text: The prime localizations of A_f are normal domains; the local criterion for normality implies that A_f is integrally closed. For any finite intermediate C, localizing its monic equations makes C_f integral over A_f inside K. Both have fraction field K, so normality gives C_f = A_f. C is a Noetherian domain because it is finite over the Noetherian domain A.

Apply openness of the normal locus to C and the image of f. The image Z_C of its closed non-normal locus under Spec C -> Spec A is closed: the algebra map is integral, and PrimeSpectrum.isClosedMap_comap_of_isIntegral applies.

For each maximal m, hLocal supplies C with m outside Z_C. A prime p contained in m cannot belong to Z_C, since Z_C is specialization-closed. The opens Spec A minus Z_C therefore cover Spec A. PrimeSpectrum.compactSpace supplies a finite subcover; retain its indexing algebras as s. Avoiding Z_C says exactly that all prime localizations of C over p are normal. No supremum or normality-transfer assertion is used in this step.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_normal_cover_family (A : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    (hAway : ∃ f : A, f ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ (p : Ideal (Localization.Away f)) [p.IsPrime],
        IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime p) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime p))
    (hLocal : ∀ (m : Ideal A) [m.IsMaximal],
      ∃ B : Subalgebra A K, B ≤ integralClosure A K ∧ Module.Finite A B ∧
        ∀ (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime], Ideal.comap (algebraMap A B) q = m →
          IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime q)) :
    ∃ s : Finset (Subalgebra A K),
      (∀ C ∈ s, C ≤ integralClosure A K ∧ Module.Finite A C) ∧
      ∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime], ∃ C ∈ s,
        ∀ (q : Ideal C) [q.IsPrime], Ideal.comap (algebraMap A C) q = p →
          IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime q)
